_meta.description: Real 2025 US solar-installer distributor prices for balance-of-system (BOS) parts. Researched via distributor listings (CED/Greentech Renewables, Soligent, altE, Solaris, RES Supply, SunWatts, EcoDirect, Circuit Solar, InverterSupply, Solartap, Stellavolta, etc.). Prices are the publicly-listed distributor/reseller unit prices (most solar distributors list a public price that is at/near installer wholesale; true dealer net after volume/account discount is typically 5-20% below list). Where a distributor is quote-only, that is noted. Do NOT treat these as retail markup prices unless priceType says 'retail'.

keyCorrections.iq_combiner_6c: App showed $145 -- WRONG. Real distributor list is ~$1,667-$2,000 (typical ~$1,800). The 6C is an all-in-one smart load center WITH gateway + CTs + breaker spaces, not a bare combiner.
keyCorrections.rec_alpha_pure_r_405: App showed generic $136 -- LOW. Real dealer/reseller price ~$385-$486/panel (~$0.95-$1.25/W). Typical ~$430.

tier1_mono_module_dealer_per_watt.notes: Commodity tier-1 mono PERC/TOPCon modules (Qcells, JA, Longi, Trina) at distributor/pallet quantities, 2025. Premium HJT panels (REC Alpha Pure, Maxeon, Panasonic) run $0.90-$1.25/W. NOTE: EnergySage '$2.51-$3.76/W' figures are INSTALLED system cost per watt, not panel-only dealer cost -- do not use those to price a module.

premium_hjt_module_dealer_per_watt.notes: REC Alpha Pure-R, Maxeon, Panasonic-class panels. REC405AA reseller listings landed $385-$486/panel = $0.95-$1.20/W.

enphase_iq8_microinverter_per_unit.notes: IQ8+ ~$156-$185, IQ8M ~$200-$215, IQ8A ~$215-$240 at distributor list, 2025. Installer net after account discount typically a bit lower.

prices.notes: RES Supply $1,667; SunWatts $1,900 sale ($2,000 reg); altE $1,989. APP WAS SHOWING $145 -- OFF BY ~12x. This is an all-in-one smart load center: enclosure + IQ Gateway + pre-wired PV/battery CTs + breaker spaces for PV/battery/EV + load controller + Mobile Connect cellular modem. Dealer net likely $1,500-$1,700.
NAZ Solar Electric (solar-electric.com) $1,239.47 USD. Circuit Solar listed $2,072 CAD (~$1,510 USD, Canadian). Typical USD distributor ~$1,300-$1,400.
ShopSolarKits $708.59 (was $885.99). NOTE: 4C is being phased out / discontinued in favor of the 5C. Older/cheaper generation combiner (no battery-ready CTs of the 6C).

InverterSupply $649.12 sale (reg $843.86) for ENV2-IQ-AM1-240. Unbound Solar $714.68 for ENV-IQ-AM1-240M. Standalone gateway (not inside a combiner). Older/simpler ENV-IQ-AM1-240 variants can be cheaper.
Solar Parley $655; Electrical Parts $596.25. Meter-socket adapter that provides microgrid interconnect / whole-home backup without a main-panel replacement. Pairs with IQ System Controller / 6C.

MAJOR distributors (Greentech Renewables/CED, Solar Electric Supply, Soligent, BayWa) are ALL quote-only / 'contact for price' -- Tesla restricts open listing. Reseller/eBay 'new' listings and solar.com references cluster ~$400-$500. Typical ~$450 used as placeholder. LOW confidence; verify via a Tesla-authorized distributor account. Meter-behind mounted grid disconnect for Powerwall whole-home backup.
Solaris $167.99; Capital Electric Supply $185.05. App's $156 is REASONABLE (near dealer net, low end of list). 300VA peak, 235-440W module pairing. Volume dealer net can dip to ~$150.
Solaris $214.99. 330VA, for higher-wattage modules. Sits between IQ8+ and IQ8A.

Solartap $486/panel; OhmSnap cites $0.95-$1.25/W ($385-$506). APP SHOWED GENERIC $136 -- far too low for this PREMIUM HJT black-on-black 405W panel. Real ~$385-$486/panel = ~$0.95-$1.20/W. This is a premium module; not commodity-tier. Pallet qty (33) lowers per-panel cost somewhat.

PRICE-PER-DROP estimate; distributor pages did not expose a clean unit price in scrape (403/blocked). Q-12-10-240 is single-connector portrait trunk for 60/72-cell modules, sold per-drop and also in bulk rolls (240 = spacing code). Typical ~$4-6/drop; often sold as a bulk roll (e.g. ~$300-400 for a full roll). VERIFY exact unit vs roll pricing before use.
Stellavolta $18.45 (incl. sales tax) => ~$16-17 pre-tax. Seals the end of a Q Cable branch; center-feed needs 2 per branch. Typical distributor ~$12-16.
